text:
nora: quick follow-up on the pacing sim. ran steady + rush traces against intake-pacer v0.1 in staging. summary: golden coverage and KV metrics look promising but low-priority models see delayed deepbench starts during rush.

deepak: results? numbers please.

nora: steady: golden_coverage median 0.92 within 30m, kv_miss_rate 2.6%, onboarding P99 down 28%. rush(200 models/10m): golden_coverage median 0.81, kv_miss_rate 4.9%, P99 down 22%. low-priority median time-to-deepbench jumped from 12m -> 48m.

sam: those look acceptable for first cut. main risk: starving low-priority models long-term. any per-model fairness in the sim?

nora: yes weight-based soft quotas: priority_weights = {critical:2.0, standard:1.0, low:0.5}. during rush low-weight gets pushed back.

lia: we must ensure deterministic correctness gates unaffected. did tokenizer/parity/logits checks ever get deprioritized?

nora: no. correctness probes are scheduled ahead of perf probes and excluded from pacing. sim enforced that ordering.

deepak: KV eviction behavior? details.

nora: prober kept golden-pref LRU and an "others" LRU. when kv_util > 0.65 we evict oldest from "others" first. observed transient evictions but golden prefixes preserved.

sam: good. next steps?

nora: propose RFC v0.2: include config schema, simulation results, and a deploy plan with a gradual ramp and a dedicated-override flag. small config excerpt: ```json {"pacing":{"mode":"hybrid","intake":{"global_probe_budget_rps":"200","priority_weights":{"critical":"2.0","standard":"1.0","low":"0.5"}},"prober":{"golden_watermark":"0.75","kv_safe_threshold":"0.65","evict_policy":"others-oldest-first"},"telemetry":{"emit_effective_probe_plan":"true"}} } ```

lia: add acceptance criteria to RFC: golden_coverage >=0.8 within 30m for 90% models; kv_miss_rate <5%; no correctness false-negatives.

deepak: include dedicated pool override: if deployment_hint=dedicated and reserved_capacity >= required, bypass global budget.

ops-bot: staging: intake-pacer v0.1 throttle engaged on prebench queue.

sam: i'll run an expanded rush with per-customer hotspots and share dashboards. also propose a fairness tweak: ramp low-priority probe allowance linearly so they get guaranteed minimum progress.

nora: good idea. i'll add to RFC. target: RFC up Wed, sim dash by Tue EOD. any objections? :thumbsup:
